DORA SQLCipher Android composite 4.17.0-dora.1

This application includes a distinct SQLCipher Android composite distributed as
com.monumentogram.dora.thirdparty:sqlcipher-android:4.17.0-dora.1.
It is not a byte-identical copy of the upstream Maven artifact.

SQLCipher and the Android wrapper: Copyright ZETETIC LLC; BSD-3-Clause.
Android-derived Java/JNI portions: Copyright The Android Open Source Project;
Apache License 2.0. SQLite: public-domain dedication. LibTomCrypt: the WTFPL
version 2 option of its upstream dual license is selected for this distribution.
NDK static runtime portions include LLVM libc++, libc++abi, libunwind and compiler
runtime support under the retained LLVM/NDK notices, including Apache License
2.0 with LLVM Exceptions and applicable legacy notices.

DORA modifications disable native diagnostic logging, JNI exception logging,
SQL profiling, and LibTomCrypt's Android clock-timing entropy fallback. The
composite uses explicit SQLCipher core 4.17.0 with SQLite 3.53.3, rather than the
Android wrapper tag's older core gitlink. Published Java classes are unchanged.
Source revisions and the exact patches are available with this application's
source at https://github.com/Monumentogram/DORA/tree/stage/8.2-encrypted-persistence/android/vendor/sqlcipher

The adjacent files retain the full upstream license and notice texts:
SQLCipher-Android.txt, SQLCipher.txt, SQLite.txt, LibTomCrypt.txt,
LLVM-NOTICE.txt, and Android-NDK-NOTICE.txt. The complete NDK notices may describe
build tools or components beyond the linked runtime; their inclusion does not
assert that those tools are shipped in this application.
